steps.name: Whereabouts of Iris
steps.objective: Go to “Luman Coalition Headquarters” and talk to [Ul].

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: His condition seemed dangerous, so I took him to a safe place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A safe place?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The Jewel School wizards are stopping her rampage from a stable location.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Iris is running wild.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Iris's fear of the devil took shape, shaking his weak heart... . That became a bit of a pain. Who would have thought that the source of darkness had entered inside... .

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Originally, I should have taken care of this, but a lot of unnecessary things have been happening at Luman recently... . As we talk, it all seems like excuses.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Haha… . I can't believe I even explained this to you. That's how short the hands are here.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So I'd like you to lend a hand. It's about Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 울

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: If you believe in Iris, it might be surprisingly possible. As you grow taller, when you see that the little boy and the strangely speaking spirit trust you so much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You mean Muwen and Zoe.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Then come back. If you don't solve it, including Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It will be the worst moment you can imagine. Well, there is no time for this. When you're ready, reach for the aisle in front of me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The kings within will explain the rest. Then please do me a favor.

steps.name: The image world of Iris
steps.objective: Go to “Belos of Memories” and talk to [Harmonia].

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: A human coming to a place like this... . Are you by any chance the person the goddess was talking about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm probably right. But when you say goddess, do you mean Ceres?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: No, it's Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris She’s a goddess… , That’s because I’m not used to it yet.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Looking at you again, I see that you have gone on a difficult journey for Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, where is this place... ? It looks really similar to Belos

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: This is the goddess’s imaginary world. Among them, it is the place that the goddess values ​​most.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belos Is it a village…? ? If so, that makes perfect sense. It is a place where I have many memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here because of the wool, but what can I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard there was something to be resolved here... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I see. Ul is you... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's both difficult and easy. Please help me keep this place from collapsing.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You know that everyone has a side of good and evil, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know. The current status of Iris is… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: A person born as a god is completely irrelevant, but a goddess… , Iris can't do that.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Even though you are a descendant of the Der tribe created by God, Iris is a human who has spent a long time with humans.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Holding, feeling and acting on various thoughts... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I have a feeling of wanting to destroy and destroy Iris's space. It mixed with the evil that came from somewhere and appeared in a new form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a part of it, but is it okay to deal with those Iris feelings?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it really okay? What authority do I have to control Iris’s feelings…? .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You don't have to worry too much about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Harmonia says so, it must be really okay, right?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. Then, please go to Mir in [Burning City].

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please help Mir, who is fending off the evil beings that are flocking there.

steps.name: Spirits of a perishing world
steps.objective: Go to “Burning City” and talk to [Mir].

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I thought I could just deliver the message and go back, but the contaminated guys attacked me without even knowing their superiors. If you are my name at this time... . Huh, what is this energy? no way!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ah, here!! Wool, welcome!! With your sword, the spirits running wild here... . Huh?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ul was busy so I came instead.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: So you're an ally, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Following in the footsteps of Iris, from Belos to here... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ah, it's him. Then please help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment. You need to explain more.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm sorry. If this place collapses, it's all over... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That said… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm sorry. I was a bit careless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how can I help you here? I can't tell which spirits are allies and enemies... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: All the spirits here are now contaminated. A polluted spirit contaminates other spirits. I'm sorry to the spirits, but Harmonia and Geas have already given permission... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . Is Mir okay? Even if the other spirits disappear... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It can't be helped. The spirits will understand too. Children who work for the world are definitely... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Mir okay from pollution?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, because I am different from regular spirits. It is also a living life... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

steps.name: Prevent destruction.
steps.objective: Go to the “Burning City” and defeat [Destructive Fire Spirit] and [Corrupted Darkness].

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm glad nothing happened. There are more children attacking me than I thought... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was okay. Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Still, thank you for doing better than I expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you please explain what the situation is?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, I will tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If we can't stop this situation, the world inside Iris is in danger, right?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That's right. You know that this is the goddess’s world of imagination, right? This world reflects the current state of the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: The ‘burning city’ here is the disappearance of civilization itself.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You can lose control of your body to an evil mind.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: The Goddess' world, where control is completely taken away, ceases to exist. It may gradually expand beyond the world of imagination and into the real world.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Not yet, so don't be afraid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Did you know that your strength is a blessing from the goddess Ceres and Iris?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: If you know, please catch the polluted spirits coming from over there!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Then be careful this time too. Did you know? I have a lot to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then please wait here.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Really... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Are you hurt anywhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there is none. are you okay.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm so glad!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Because they are spirits that serve life, it is hard to see anyone getting hurt.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: By the way, what do you think about the guys you just faced?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems different from the spirit here. I don't think it's a spirit. I feel strangely bad. Is it because I have particularly strong malicious intent? ?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Nice to see you. They are evil servants of the Evil Order.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Evil Order… ?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: The Evil Order is a being born from the goddess's malice... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It can be said that they are beings filled with only negative emotions about this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris's evil and negative mind is created like that... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes… , maybe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer and Iris are really working hard... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Please work hard even though the road to rescue is arduous and difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Iris in both states collapses, will Iris be okay?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It'll be okay for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try it. I can do it well... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, I will believe it. The goddess also believes in Adventurer... .

steps.name: another world
steps.objective: Go to the “Burning City” and talk to [Geas].

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You are the goddess's helper... , I didn’t expect to actually see it.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It feels like I met you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's wool, you're saying it as a compliment, right?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The spirit carries no malice. I wouldn't know if it was contaminated. The only reason I felt your energy was because I was the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirit King? Ah, then you are a spirit. The other spirits are in strange condition, but they seem to be okay.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Ah, I'm fine. The power that the goddess gave me to take care of the children was used to save my life... . I just feel sorry for the children and the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be too sorry.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I'm glad you came. I was barely able to stop the children and evil spirits polluted by the source of darkness... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Harmonia, Mir... . You'll barely be able to hold on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand Harmonia, but is Mir also the Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Although he is not a perfect spirit, he is a child with power comparable to that of the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: In some ways, they are more special than us. It is rare for a spirit to be able to move completely freely between images and the real world... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Maybe it was able to fight against malice because it was not a complete spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Mir, who saved his life with the help of a spirit when he was young, gained the characteristics of a spirit, which he considers a blessing.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: No, this is not the time. I believe in your strength and want to ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: With what I see of you, your power, talent, and will, I think you can save ‘that world.’

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Go to the "Canyon of Chaos" and slay the evil entity that seeks to destroy the world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: There is the being you are looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Come on, come back... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: That's amazing. I've heard of your skills, but you're more amazing than I imagined.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Even if it was just a fragment of a part of the Goddess' heart, I never thought I could deal with it like that.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I didn't know you were that strong.

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: As the goddess had an incomplete awakening, I was worried that you might also be feeling uneasy somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Looking at your performance, it seems there is no need to worry.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You have come this far for the Goddess. And he is also a believer in the Goddess. So there is no need to doubt any more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: There is work for you to do. This time, let’s go to the ‘Frozen World’.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: There will be an Evil Order there, trying to cover up everything with malicious intent.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A being that endlessly craves destruction and seeks to repeat it.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Another heart with as much hatred as the goddess has for the world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It can be said that it is an ordeal that anyone who rises to the rank goes through, but for the goddess, it can be said to be severe.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The ordeal of facing a situation in which you are not yet prepared can be truly harsh... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Even if you survive this difficult ordeal, you will meet a harsher fate.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: But if you are there to help me... , I believe that we will definitely be able to overcome it.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Oh, is it already gone…? . After all, it is fate that has no choice but to follow the goddess as much as its actions. Please take care of me. you… .

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Wow! You really came. He's a speedless human. It's really fun.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What on earth are you thinking, continuing to help her after being used like that? That's really funny.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Although I am a funny person, I am not a funny person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's even funnier is that an evil being like you ascends to the status of a star god.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Weak Iris, evil me. Anyway, no matter which of the two becomes the Holy God, this world will be a mess.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: The world is going to be a mess anyway, so what if it becomes me? So, I wish I could go back at this point♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't leave it alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't do that... .

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Hehe, that's fun. The existence of you in the place Iris dreams of is so interesting.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Why do you think you should help her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry if it seemed like I was just helping. Now the work I do is no longer just for Iris.

lines.speaker: 이블오더

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 이블오더

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 이블오더

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Even if you say that, how long can you hold out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, let's do it. Let's see how long we can say that.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Anyway, I'll deal with you one more time. This stupid human… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will deal with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Iris… ? Iris Is that right? Ah, the heart of Iris? Because the real thing is out there.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I was already wondering where my weakest heart had gone, but it was here.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: During this time, I was covered in darkness and couldn't see myself, so I couldn't do anything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine. Thanks to you, I have the strength to fight the Evil Order. I'll do it now, so please step back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Since Iris says so, I will step down.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Evil Order is a part of my heart. Therefore, it has vitality and power comparable to that of a god.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even if you can deal with it, you cannot completely destroy it. So I have to do it. In the inner ‘imaginary world’… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it like a fight with yourself?

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I will destroy you all here... Wow. What is this power?

lines.text: Me, where are you taking me? It shouldn't be like this!!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You and I are part of Iris's heart. I will go to a place that only my heart can go to. Let's solve it within it without causing any harm to everyone.

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay inside the mental world, so please let the spirit kings know. I feel like I will have to fight against Evil Order for quite some time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And see you again in the main body, %s… .

lines.text: Human good and evil always fight within. This is a process that a goddess who ascended from a human to a god must go through from time to time.

lines.speaker: 기아스

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: 하르모니아

lines.speaker: %s

lines.text: Goddess will be okay. You're not perfect yet... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If you remain stable, endure trials, and overcome, you will become a proper god.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Until then, please help me Goddess. Everyone says they can trust Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I believe in you too and want to help you.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: See you later then. If you are where you first started, you will be able to return to your original position.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You have returned from the world of illusions. Even if they went there, no one came back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It was that kind of place. It was okay though. Because it ended well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I looked busy, I came to ask Yuran about the status of Iris.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's relatively okay. He has stopped running wild and is getting a good night's sleep. So would you please tell me the story of that place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Yuran what happened in Iris's mental world.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm… . I've already been thinking about it a bit. This is also what the teacher requested... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It seems that Iris will take some time to fully awaken.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Since many enemies are targeting you and there are still things you are afraid of, it will likely take some time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Let me summarize it briefly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's not an easy way, but... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris I have searched for every possible way to help you become a stronger god.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Among them, there is one method that seems possible... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess that's my job.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Then let me tell you. That's what happens... .
